integrity: The proof uses only the published CTMC state space and transition rates. It constructs a finite event path with strictly positive jump rates and then proves the same path can occur within every positive time horizon. The bundled checker replays the rate-sign calculation and the zero-count confidence endpoint; no unobserved simulation result is treated as evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem establishes strict positive reachability, not a practically useful lower bound for the rare-event probability.

The exact reachability proof concerns the continuous-time Markov chain defined by the published transition rates; the article's tau-leaping simulation is a numerical approximation whose discretization error is not quantified here.
The result does not dispute that immune-cytokine feedback can reduce invasion probability by many orders of magnitude relative to a frozen branching approximation.
The zero-count confidence calculation assumes independent Bernoulli simulation outcomes.
title: The full tumor–immune CTMC has no finite zero-invasion immune threshold
